meta.severity: 4 blocks a task or WCAG A on a core flow; 3 WCAG A/AA failure or missing state on a primary flow; 2 inconsistency or friction; 1 cosmetic or smell

kinds.static: detected by audit.mjs from source text; heuristic, verify before fixing
kinds.rendered: needs the page rendered in a browser
kinds.judgment: needs a human or model reading the UI

rules.title: Focus outline removed with no replacement
rules.fix: Keep the outline, or add a :focus-visible ring of 2px with at least 3:1 contrast.

rules.title: Browser zoom disabled in the viewport meta tag
rules.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1.

rules.title: <html> has no lang attribute
rules.fix: Set lang to the page language.

rules.title: Image without alt text
rules.fix: Describe the image, or use alt="" when it is decorative.

rules.title: Click handler on a non-interactive element
rules.fix: Use <button> for actions and <a> for navigation.

rules.title: Icon-only button with no accessible name
rules.fix: Add aria-label, or visible text.

rules.title: Input relies on its placeholder as the label
rules.fix: Add a visible <label> above the field; keep the placeholder for an example only.

rules.title: Clickable target smaller than 24px
rules.fix: Give the control at least 24x24 CSS px (44px on touch layouts) with padding or min size.

rules.title: Data is fetched and listed with no loading or error branch
rules.fix: Add a skeleton for loading and an error view with retry.

rules.title: List has no empty state
rules.fix: Explain what belongs here and offer the action that creates the first item.

rules.title: Positive tabindex overrides the natural focus order
rules.fix: Use 0 or -1 and order the DOM instead.

rules.title: Hard-coded color instead of a token
rules.fix: Map each value to an existing token, or add one token for the cluster.

rules.title: Off-scale size or spacing value
rules.fix: Use the nearest step of the spacing or type scale.

rules.title: Text smaller than 12px
rules.fix: Use 12px at the very least; 14-16px for anything users must read.

rules.title: Error message does not say what happened or what to do
rules.fix: Name the problem and the fix, reusing the field's label.

rules.title: Animations present but prefers-reduced-motion is never honored
rules.fix: Disable or shorten non-essential motion under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.title: transition: all
rules.fix: List the properties that actually change, preferably transform and opacity.

rules.title: Emoji used in the interface
rules.fix: If it stands in for an icon, use the project's icon set.

rules.title: Default purple gradient or gradient text
rules.fix: Keep only if it is the brand. Otherwise use the project's primary color.

rules.title: Text contrast below 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text)
rules.fix: Check each text/background pair with contrast.mjs and adjust the token.

rules.title: Input borders, icons or focus ring below 3:1
rules.fix: Darken or lighten the token until it reaches 3:1.

rules.title: Horizontal scroll at the current width (check 320px)
rules.fix: Let content wrap or stack; remove fixed widths.

rules.title: Tab order does not follow the visual order, or focus is hidden behind sticky content
rules.fix: Order the DOM to match; add scroll-margin under sticky headers.

rules.title: Dialog does not trap focus, close on Escape or return focus
rules.fix: Use <dialog> or the component library's dialog.

rules.title: Content is wider than its box and spills over neighbours
rules.fix: Let the text wrap, allow the box to grow, or reduce the columns at this width.

rules.title: Rendered control smaller than 24x24 CSS px
rules.fix: Add padding or a minimum size.

rules.title: Controls smaller than 44px on a phone-width viewport
rules.fix: Make touch controls 44px tall and wide.

rules.title: Rendered control with no accessible name
rules.fix: Add visible text or aria-label.

rules.title: Rendered form field with no label
rules.fix: Associate a <label>, or add aria-label.

rules.title: Text cut off with no ellipsis
rules.fix: Let it wrap, or truncate with an ellipsis and expose the full text.

rules.title: Heading levels skipped, or not exactly one h1
rules.fix: Use one h1 and do not skip levels.

rules.title: Hover, active or disabled state missing or indistinct
rules.fix: See references/states.md.

rules.title: More than one visually dominant action in a view
rules.fix: Keep one primary; demote the rest to secondary or tertiary.

rules.title: Spacing does not show what belongs together
rules.fix: Make gaps inside a group smaller than gaps between groups.

rules.title: Same role built differently in different places
rules.fix: Pick one component and one name per role.

rules.title: Destructive action with no confirmation or undo
rules.fix: Add a confirm step or an undo window.

rules.title: Action gives no feedback while it runs
rules.fix: Disable the control, keep its label and show an indicator.

rules.title: Color is the only cue for meaning
rules.fix: Add text, an icon or a shape.

rules.title: Alt text or label does not describe the purpose
rules.fix: Write what the image or control is for.

rules.title: Layout breaks with long text, missing images or extreme counts
rules.fix: Test with the stress content in references/states.md.
